tiers.name: Diamond Partner
benefits: Exclusive title of 'Infinity Diamond Partner' for Infinity 2025
Most prominent logo placement on all materials with 'Proudly Supported by' designation
Featured full-page advertisement in all event booklets and digital materials
Premium booth/stall location at Infinity 2025
Opportunity to deliver keynote address at Infinity 2025 main day
Exclusive right to host your own event
First access to student recruitment opportunities
Feature story in annual department magazine and all KUMSC social media
Recognition plaque and logo placement on KUMSC merchandise

tiers.name: Platinum Partner
benefits: Prominent logo placement on club website, banners, and promotional materials
Named sponsorship of one major event (Mathematical Olympiad or Talk Series)
Booth/stall at Infinity 2025
Invitations to networking events with KUMSC members
Acknowledgment in all event communications
Social media featured posts
Recognition plaque and logo on selected Infinity 2025 merchandise

tiers.name: Gold Partner
benefits: Logo placement on event promotional materials and website with backlinks
Booth/stall at Infinity 2025
Invitation to judge competitions
Acknowledgment during opening/closing ceremonies
Social media recognition
Recognition plaque

tiers.name: Silver Partner
benefits: Logo placement on event promotional materials and club website listing
Verbal recognition at events
Social media mention
Certificate of appreciation

tiers.name: Bronze Partner
benefits: Name listed on club website
Logo placement on event promotional materials
Acknowledgment in event programs
Certificate of appreciation

tiers.name: Equipment Sponsor-Tier 1
benefits: All Silver Partner benefits
Equipment will display ’Provided by [Sponsor]’ tags
Featured in special ’Technology Partners’ section on website
Photos of equipment in use shared on social media

tiers.name: Equipment Sponsor-Tier 2
benefits: All Bronze Partner benefits
’Provided by [Sponsor]’ acknowledgment
Photos of equipment in use shared on social media

tiers.name: Refreshment Sponsor
benefits: Exclusive designation as 'Official Refreshment Partner'
Branding on food and beverage stations at sponsored events
Opportunity to distribute product samples to participants
Speaking opportunity during event breaks
Logo on event materials with 'Refreshments provided by' designation
Benefits comparable to Gold Partner tier

tiers.name: Event-Specific Sponsor
benefits: Named recognition for specific events (Hackathon, Olympiad, Workshops)
Judge positions at sponsored events
Distribution of company challenges
Recruiting opportunities from participant pool
Brand visibility throughout competition materials
Opportunity to suggest workshop topics and presenters

tiers.name: In-Kind Support
benefits: Venue provision for events
Refreshments for meetings and small events
Printing services for promotional materials
Transportation services
Software licenses and cloud computing resources
Books, educational resources, and competition prizes
Recognition level based on estimated value
